title: NIST WebBook: Carbon dioxide is CO2, molecular weight 44.0095 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Carbon dioxide as CO2, molecular weight 44.0095 amu, CAS 124-38-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Carbon dioxide, CAS Registry Number 124-38-9, lists molecular formula CO2 and molecular weight 44.0095 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 43.9898292 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CO2/c2-1-3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
